recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if Pharmacy identifies specific current Medication examples whose generated page, list description, or resource content is misleading or insufficient.
issue_request: FHIR-8071 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for FHIR-core-Medication from the DSTU1 ballot. It said Medication examples did not give enough detail to describe what the example was intended to show and that the narrative did not provide all detail; the recorded resolution was to fix examples.
initial_application: No current-history commit was found with the Jira key itself. The likely application path is the post-vote Medication example work in git 27d6d851e8, which added grouped descriptive example links to source/medication/medication-examples-header.xml, followed by git 0cb04d2656 correcting the example set. A separate commit mentioning #8071 changed MedicationAdministration SNOMED codes and does not appear to apply this Medication-resource example-detail request.
additional_context: Medication is active in the current build according to source/fhir.ini. The 2021 source rework migrated example metadata into source/medication/list-Medication-examples.xml, which currently has 25 Medication example entries and title/description metadata describing manufactured product, generic formulation, compounded preparation, ingredient-reference, comparator, fully populated, and minimal examples. FHIR-8069 uses similar ballot wording for MedicationDispense but concerns a separate artifact and was not decided here.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current source already supplies the implementer-facing example context requested by FHIR-8071, and adding duplicate narrative text across individual example resources would be broad, redundant, and unsupported by the terse Jira resolution.

related_jiras.note: Same ballot wording for MedicationDispense, but it concerns a separate artifact and needs its own bounded reconciliation.
